newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa Bank says may not recover loans to Tada Corp.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Bank says may not recover loans to Tada Corp.

text.p: Daiwa Bank Ltd said on Thursday that it may not be able to recover 1.9 billion yen worth of loans to Tada Corp.
Tada Corp, a major Japanese construction company, announced on Wednesday it had filed for court protection with debts totalling 171.4 billion yen.
Tada also said that its debts exceeded its assets by more than 30 billion yen as of March 31.

Daiwa Bank said it would make provisions for the potential loan losses during the first half of the 1997/98 business year. The bank added, however, that it does not expect its earnings forecast for the current business year to be significantly affected by the possible loan loss.
